name: Zombie Soldier A
notes: A Meshy community model, CC0 per the owner (from the owner's Drive folder, 2026-11-01, second batch; the community model's name as the download names it): a textured GLB in a T-pose, not rigged (no skin), so it is rigged here from T-pose landmarks found on the mesh (landmarks.mjs). A skeleton paratrooper in an olive jacket and helmet, with a field pack and bone hands. A variant of Dog Tag Doyle since 2026-11-26 (owner: one character with variant looks, like the chimp's; this id kept, so a saved pick plays this look on Dog Tag Doyle's picker).
